dict.string: extensionItems.@count == 1 AND SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, ($item.attachments.@count == 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $p, ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR (ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NOT ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")).@count == 1) OR ($item.attachments.@count == 2 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $p, ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NOT ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url").@count == 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $p, ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text").@count >= 1)).@count == 1
